beats.text: Ask an AI to fix a broken form, and it will tell you it's fixed. The page loads. A confirmation appears. But did the user's booking actually get saved, correctly?
beats.spoken: Ask an AI to fix a broken form, and it will tell you it's fixed. The page loads. A confirmation appears. But did the user's booking actually get saved, correctly?

beats.text: Here, the booking page says success. But the database stored the wrong phone number. Nobody notices, unless you check what was saved.
beats.spoken: Here, the booking page says success. But the database stored the wrong phone number. Nobody notices, unless you check what was saved.

beats.text: AccessFinish drives the journey in a real browser, then hands the evidence and the source code to NVIDIA Nemotron, on Nebius Token Factory. No hints. Nemotron finds the hard-coded value, and writes the fix.
beats.spoken: AccessFinish drives the journey in a real browser, then hands the evidence and the source code to NVIDIA Nemo-tron, on Nebius Token Factory. No hints. Nemo-tron finds the hard-coded value, and writes the fix.

beats.text: Every fix is built in a fresh, offline sandbox, and checked for real: the saved database row, a fresh browser, and a second customer with a different number. Twenty-seven live runs. Twenty-seven verified fixes, for about a cent each.
beats.spoken: Every fix is built in a fresh, offline sandbox, and checked for real: the saved database row, a fresh browser, and a second customer with a different number. Twenty-seven live runs. Twenty-seven verified fixes, for about a cent each.

beats.text: Now a real bug from the open-source app. A keyboard user can't reach the date picker at all.
beats.spoken: Now a real bug from the open-source app. A keyboard user can't reach the date picker at all.

beats.text: Nemotron makes the date reachable, and the page says the booking is confirmed. But AccessFinish reads the database. Saved for the wrong day. Rejected.
beats.spoken: Nemo-tron makes the date reachable, and the page says the booking is confirmed. But AccessFinish reads the database. Saved for the wrong day. Rejected.

beats.text: And it shows which code did it. Half a second after the date is typed, the month-change handler fetches unavailable dates, and overwrites what the user typed.
beats.spoken: And it shows which code did it. Half a second after the date is typed, the month-change handler fetches unavailable dates, and overwrites what the user typed.

beats.text: With that evidence, Nemotron fixes the reset, and the right date is saved. But reopening the booking shows today's date. A second bug.
beats.spoken: With that evidence, Nemo-tron fixes the reset, and the right date is saved. But reopening the booking shows today's date. A second bug.

beats.text: Nemotron fixes that too, and keeps its first fix. Verified: saved, reopened in a fresh browser, and the mouse path still works. No hints.
beats.spoken: Nemo-tron fixes that too, and keeps its first fix. Verified: saved, reopened in a fresh browser, and the mouse path still works. No hints.

beats.text: Across twenty-seven keyboard runs, seventy-seven false booked confirmations were caught. Not one got through.
beats.spoken: Across twenty-seven keyboard runs, seventy-seven false booked confirmations were caught. Not one got through.

beats.text: Fifty-four live runs, for about six dollars of Nemotron. Fixes that are proven, not promised.
beats.spoken: Fifty-four live runs, for about six dollars of Nemo-tron. Fixes that are proven, not promised.

beats.text: AccessFinish. Finish the task. Verify the result.
